name: Business owner shares a public enquiry form and receives a lead review task
covers: public marketing landing page and sign-in entry
workspace WhatsApp integration status and Meta setup guardrail
description: Verifies a business owner can enable a public enquiry link and a visitor submission is saved as a lead with an automatic review task.
steps: Open the public LeadLoop landing page and review its platform sections and free-trial call to action
Select Start free trial and sign in as a new business owner
Create a workspace named Northstar Services
Open Settings and enable the public enquiry form
Inspect the WhatsApp Business integration card and its connection status
Copy and open the public enquiry link in a visitor session
Submit an enquiry for Sam Test with email sam@example.com and the message I need a quote
Sign in to the Northstar Services workspace and open Leads
Open Tasks and return to the dashboard
expected: The public landing page explains the available LeadLoop workspace capabilities and opens the existing sign-in flow from its free-trial call to action. Settings shows the WhatsApp Business integration as not connected, explains that LeadLoop Meta setup and approval are still required, and does not allow a false connection. The public form identifies Northstar Services, the visitor sees a submission confirmation, Sam Test appears as a New website enquiry lead, a linked Open task named Review new lead: Sam Test appears, and the dashboard lead count includes the submission.

name: Employee accepts an invitation and receives assigned access
description: Verifies an invited employee can join the correct business workspace and access its permitted records.
steps: Actor A signs in as workspace owner and creates an employee invitation for staff@example.com
Actor A copies the generated invitation link
Actor B signs in with staff@example.com and opens the invitation link
Actor B accepts the invitation
expected: Actor B is added to the invited workspace as an employee and can view workspace records without gaining owner-only team controls.

name: Create and update an invoice with durable state
covers: appointment creation with date and time
description: Verifies a finance-capable workspace member can create and update an invoice and see the saved state after reload.
steps: Open Invoices
Create an invoice for Client Example with amount 1250 and status Draft
Change its status to Sent
Refresh the page
Open Calendar and create a consultation for Client Example from 10:00 to 11:00 on a free date
Create a second appointment for the same staff member that overlaps the first appointment
Refresh Calendar
expected: The invoice remains visible with the amount R1,250.00 and status Sent. The LeadLoop Calendar shows the saved consultation on its selected date after refresh, and the overlapping appointment is rejected with a clear conflict message.

name: Use the unified AI to draft and approve a customer reply
covers: AI message drafting from exact lead record
description: Verifies the unified AI drafts an email from an exact lead record, approval opens a pre-filled email compose handoff, and manual status is clearly distinguished from provider-verified delivery.
steps: Create a new public enquiry for Sam Example with email sam@example.com and contact consent enabled
Open the unified AI assistant
Ask: Draft an email reply to the newest lead, Sam Example, acknowledging the enquiry and asking what service they need. Do not send it.
Open Messages
Approve the saved draft as the workspace owner
Open the Gmail compose link and verify the recipient, subject and body are pre-filled
Send the email manually in Gmail, return to LeadLoop and select Mark sent manually
expected: The approved email has a pre-filled mailto compose link. After the user manually sends it and marks it sent, LeadLoop displays Sent (marked manually) and explicitly states that provider delivery is not verified.

name: Reject incomplete public enquiries and unauthorized actions
description: Verifies a visitor cannot submit an incomplete enquiry or skip consent and non-owner members cannot approve customer messages.
steps: Open a public enquiry link on a mobile viewport
Leave the name empty and attempt to submit
Enter a name but leave both email and phone empty
Provide contact details but leave the consent checkbox unchecked
Sign in as an employee and attempt to approve a pending message draft
expected: Incomplete submissions are blocked, contact consent is required, no invalid lead is created, and employees cannot approve customer messages.
